authorization.scope: No cloud account, paid GPU, purchase, or external mutation is authorized in this worktree.

base_model.license_review: Required: inspect the model card and revision-specific terms before execution.

dataset.rights_review: Repository-authored practice data; retain repository license and do not present as a benchmark.

planned_run.checkpoint_policy: Save adapter and run manifest only after a successful bounded step; delete ephemeral compute after evidence capture.
stop_conditions: Stop before launch if approval, rights, model revision, or provider price is missing.
Stop immediately at the runtime, storage, or cost ceiling.
Stop on non-finite loss, frozen-base mutation, missing adapter gradients, or data leakage.
Stop and preserve a sanitized failure manifest on provider/network/checkpoint failure.

evaluation.baseline: same frozen base revision, tokenizer, prompt format, and held-out test partition before adapter loading
evaluation.after: same held-out test partition with the saved adapter reloaded
evaluation.success_criteria: Predeclare direction only: lower held-out loss/perplexity without a material regression on the fixed sanity prompts. No improvement is claimed until measured.

recovery.restart_command: Start a new work directory with the same contract after reviewing the sanitized failure manifest; real-mode resume is intentionally unsupported.

limitations: No cloud execution was attempted; null measured fields are unavailable, not zero.
The checked-in artifacts are local random-weight smoke evidence and cannot establish open-model quality.
One short run and synthetic data cannot establish generalization or a useful adapter.
Provider pricing, quota, model revision, and rights must be rechecked at execution time.
